sidebar.title: Your organizer navigation
sidebar.description: This sidebar is how you move around your organization: overview, events, leaderboards, members, payouts and more. The section you are on is highlighted in green.

title.title: Welcome to your organizer overview
title.description: This is your organization's home base. It gives you a quick read on your activity at a glance.

stats.title: Your headline numbers
stats.description: These tiles summarise your organization, for example how many members and events you have. A fast health check before you dive in.

title.title: Your organization profile
title.description: Manage how your organization appears across the site: its logo, banner, name, description and social links.

images.title: Logo and banner
images.description: Upload the logo and banner that brand your organization's page and events. Drop an image or click to choose a file.

save.title: Save your changes
save.description: Apply any edits you make to the profile. Nothing changes for the public until you save.

title.title: Your events
title.description: Every tournament and scrim your organization is running lives here. Create new ones and manage the existing ones from this page.

create.title: Create an event
create.description: Start a new tournament or scrim. A wizard walks you through details, stages, prizes and rules, then publishes it.

table.title: Your events list
table.description: Each row is one event. Use the row actions to view it, edit it, manage its results and leaderboard, set up groups and rosters, or copy its links.

title.title: Create a new event
title.description: This wizard builds a tournament or scrim from scratch for your organization, one step at a time.

form.title: Work through the steps
form.description: Each step collects part of the event: details, stages, prize pool, rules and more. Use Next and Back to move between them.

submit.title: Publish your event
submit.description: On the final step, create the event to publish it. You can also save it as a draft and finish later.

title.title: Your draft events
title.description: Events you started but have not published yet are saved here so you can finish them when you are ready.

create.title: Start a new event
create.description: Begin a fresh event from the same wizard. It will appear here as a draft until you publish it.

table.title: Your drafts list
table.description: Each row is an unpublished event. Continue editing to reopen it in the wizard, or delete one you no longer need.

title.title: Event detail
title.description: The hub for a single event. From here you reach everything about it: its settings, registrations, groups and results.

edit.title: Edit this event
edit.description: Reopen the event in the wizard to change any detail, stage, prize or rule after it has been created.

links.title: Linked and qualification events
links.description: See how this event connects to others, for example which events qualify teams into it or follow on from it.

title.title: Edit event
title.description: Change any part of an existing event. Your edits apply once you save them.

tabs.title: Edit by section
tabs.description: Each tab edits one area of the event: basic info, registered teams, stages and groups, prizes and rules, sponsor and waitlist settings, and publish actions.

title.title: Groups and rosters
title.description: See who is seeded into which group for this event, and check every team's roster before play begins.

search.title: Find a player or team fast
search.description: Search by in-game name, team or UID to jump straight to a competitor across all the groups.

stages.title: Stages and their groups
stages.description: Each card is a stage, broken down into its groups and the teams seeded into them. A quick way to confirm the bracket is set up correctly.

title.title: Event leaderboard
title.description: View and manage the standings for this event. This is where raw match results become the published ranking.

stageTabs.title: Pick a stage
stageTabs.description: Switch between the event's stages to see the standings for each one.

table.title: The standings table
table.description: Placements, kills and total points for every competitor. Use the upload and edit controls to enter or correct match results.

title.title: Leaderboards
title.description: Manage the results and standings for all of your organization's events from one place.

search.title: Find an event
search.description: Search your events by name, type or status to quickly locate the one you want to score.

table.title: Your events to score
table.description: Each row is an event you can attach or update a leaderboard for. Open one to upload results manually or by screenshot, configure points, and view or edit standings.

wizard.title: Create a standalone leaderboard
wizard.description: Build a leaderboard that is not tied to a full event. This wizard walks you through the basics, the point system, the match results and a final review before you publish.

view.title: Standalone leaderboard
view.description: View the published standings for this standalone leaderboard. If you manage it, you can also reopen it to edit the results.

title.title: Your organization's members
title.description: Manage who belongs to your organization and what each person is allowed to do.

add.title: Add a sub-organizer
add.description: Invite another user into your organization and grant them the permissions they need, for example creating events or uploading results.

table.title: The members table
table.description: Every member with their role and permissions. Adjust what someone can do, or remove them, from here.

title.title: Your payouts
title.description: Track your organization's share of paid-event revenue and keep your bank details up to date so you can be paid out.

stats.title: Owed and paid at a glance
stats.description: These cards show how much you are owed and how much has already been paid out to your organization.

table.title: Your earnings ledger
table.description: A line for every payout, showing the event, the amount and its status. Your full revenue history in one place.

title.title: Your metrics
title.description: Aggregate stats for your organization across events, teams, players, kills and ratings.

stats.title: Headline metrics
stats.description: These cards summarise your organization's totals for the selected period. A quick read on how you are performing.

tabs.title: Dig into the trends
tabs.description: The tabs break the numbers down further, for example trends over time and per-area breakdowns, so you can spot what is growing.

title.title: Your reviews
title.description: See the ratings and feedback players have left on your organization's events.

events.title: Ratings per event
events.description: Each event shows its average rating and lets you expand to read the comments. All comments are anonymous to keep feedback honest.

title.title: Leaderboard design
title.description: Customise how your organization's leaderboards look, for example their colours and logos.

manager.title: Manage your designs
manager.description: Upload and adjust the design assets applied to your leaderboards. Changes here flow through to your published standings.

title.title: Your blacklists
title.description: Block a team, and the players on it, from registering for your organization's events. You can also review requests to lift a block.

add.title: Blacklist a team
add.description: Add a team to your blacklist so it can no longer register for your events. The players on its roster are captured at the same time.

table.title: Blacklisted teams
table.description: Every team you have blocked, with the roster captured when you added it. Expand a row to see the snapshot, or lift the block when appropriate.

manager.title: The shared watchlist
manager.description: A community-wide advisory list of suspicious players and teams that admins and organizers share. It is a warning, not a ban, so you know who to watch out for. Search it, or add an entry with a reason.

nav.noOrgMembership: You aren't a member of any organization yet.

design.title: Design
design.description: Build branded leaderboard designs: upload backgrounds, set colours, and drag your logos. Pick a design when you export a leaderboard.

toast.orgDeleted: Organization deleted. An AFC admin can restore it if needed.

remove.confirmDesc: This removes {name} from the organization. They will lose all access. This action cannot be undone.

org.suspendedDesc: Your organization is suspended and hidden from the public site.
org.activeDesc: Suspend hides your org and its events from the public site. Delete is reversible by an AFC admin.
org.deleteConfirmDesc: Your organization and its events will be hidden from the site. This is a soft delete: an AFC admin can restore everything intact. Your events and results are always retained.

leave.title: Leave organization
leave.desc: Remove yourself from this organization. You will lose access to its dashboard.
leave.confirmDesc: You will be removed from this organization and lose access to its dashboard. An owner can re-invite you later.

payouts.title: Payouts
payouts.accountDesc: Where AFC sends your share once an event's revenue is released.
payouts.empty: No earnings yet. Earnings appear once a paid event's revenue is released.

reviews.anonymityNotice: Ratings and comments are anonymous, only the feedback text and date are shown, never who left it.
reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.lockDescription: Ratings and feedback on your events.
reviews.noPermission: You don't have permission to view this organization's reviews.
reviews.description: Ratings and anonymous feedback on each of your events.
reviews.noEvents: Your organization hasn't run any events yet, so there's no feedback to show.
reviews.noComments: No comments on this event yet.

metrics.description: A performance dashboard for your organization, across all of its events.
metrics.descriptionShort: A performance dashboard for your organization.
metrics.lockNotice: You don't have permission to view this organization's metrics.
metrics.emptyNoEvents: Your organization hasn't run any events yet. Metrics appear here once you have created and run your first event.
metrics.emptyNoActivity: No activity in this timeframe. Try a wider range (or All time) to see registrations, views, matches, and ratings.

cards.uniqueViewers: {count, plural, one {{formatted} unique viewer} other {{formatted} unique viewers}}

charts.prizeEmpty: No prize payouts recorded yet. This chart fills in once event payouts are entered.
charts.noTeamStats: No team match stats recorded yet.
charts.noPlayerStats: No player match stats recorded yet.

events.emptyTable: No events with activity in this timeframe. Try a wider range.

blacklists.title: Blacklists
blacklists.description: Block a team (and the players on it) from registering for your events.
blacklists.lockedDescription: Block teams from registering for your events.
blacklists.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage this organization's blacklists.

table.title: Blacklisted teams ({count})

snapshot.empty: No players were snapshotted on this blacklist.

decide.notePlaceholder: Add a short note for the requester.

lookup.title: Blacklist lookup
lookup.description: Check whether a team or player has been blacklisted by other organizations: how many times, by whom, and when. Reasons stay private to the blacklisting organization.
lookup.teamPlaceholder: Search a team to look up...
lookup.playerPlaceholder: Search a player to look up...
lookup.notBlacklistedWindow: has not been blacklisted in the selected time frame.

toast.pickDates: Pick a start and end date, with the end date after the start.

profile.title: Profile
profile.readOnly: Only the organization owner can edit branding. You have read-only access to this section.
profile.socialsEmpty: No social links yet. Add one below.

image.invalidType: Only PNG, JPG, JPEG, or WEBP files are supported.

eventsList.title: Events
eventsList.empty: Your organization hasn't created any events yet.

toast.unpublished: Event unpublished. It is now a draft.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.description: Finish and publish your organization's draft events.
drafts.empty: Your organization has no draft events. Start one and save it as a draft to finish later.
drafts.noPermission: You do not have permission to manage draft events for this organization.

leaderboards.title: Leaderboards
leaderboards.description: Upload results and manage your events' leaderboards.
leaderboards.noPermission: You do not have permission to manage results for this organization.
leaderboards.searchPlaceholder: Search events by name, type, or status...
leaderboards.emptyEvents: Your organization hasn't created any events yet, so there are no leaderboards to manage.
leaderboards.noMatch: No events match your search query.

eventDetail.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage this organization's events.
eventDetail.notFound: That event was not found in this organization.
eventDetail.description: Manage this event's qualification links, or jump to its task pages.

exportGraphic.dialogDescription: Pick the stage and group to show, render those standings onto a branded design, and download it as an image.

exportGraphic.title: Title
exportGraphic.subtitle: Subtitle

obsOverlay.dialogDescription: Build a link to drop into OBS, vMix, or any software as a Browser Source. It shows your chosen design with live standings that update on their own.
obsOverlay.columnsHint: These are the columns placed on the chosen design. Uncheck any you want to hide on the overlay.
obsOverlay.liveHelp: Show in-round scores as teams play. Requires the desktop capture client running on the host PC. Rich stat columns (deaths, knockdowns, and the rest) only fill while live.
obsOverlay.followHelp: Leave the stage and group out of the link so the overlay shows whatever you set in the Broadcast control. Then switch stage/group live from the Broadcast control, no OBS change.
obsOverlay.obsHint: In your streaming software (OBS, vMix, etc.): add a Browser Source and paste this link. Set the width and height to match the size you picked.
obsOverlay.copyError: Could not copy the link. Select it and copy manually.
obsOverlay.regenerated: Token regenerated. Update any link already in OBS.
obsOverlay.tokenError: Could not prepare the overlay token.

broadcast.title: Broadcast control
broadcast.description: Choose what the live overlay shows. Switch the stage or group, or combine them into a cumulative, and the overlay follows within seconds. No OBS change needed.
broadcast.loadError: Could not load the broadcast selection.
broadcast.customGroupsHint: Pick the groups to merge into one cumulative standings board.
broadcast.noGroups: No groups to choose from yet.
broadcast.noneLive: Nothing is live yet. Pick a selection and set it live.
broadcast.setSuccess: The overlay now follows this selection.
broadcast.setError: Could not update the broadcast selection.
broadcast.followHint: The overlay picks this up on its own, no OBS change needed.
